component.name: KSharePreview
component.summary: Preview OpenGraph metadata and banner images for links on KDE Plasma
Visualize metadados OpenGraph e banners de links no KDE Plasma

description.p: KSharePreview is a lightweight, native KDE Plasma (Qt6 / Kirigami) application to inspect social sharing metadata (OpenGraph, Twitter/X Cards, HTML meta tags) and banner images from any URL.
Initial release with OpenGraph/Twitter Card previews, banner viewer/downloader, and metadata inspector.
